{{Short description|UN list of countries and territories by population}}

[[File:United Nations geographical subregions.png|thumb|350px|Statistical subregions as [[United Nations geoscheme|defined by]] the [[United Nations Statistics Division]]<ref name=UNregions>{{cite web |title=Standard country or area codes for statistical use (M49) |url=https://unstats.un.org/unsd/methodology/m49/ |publisher=[[United Nations Statistics Division]]}}</ref>]]

This is a list of [[list of sovereign states|countries]] and other [[dependent territory|inhabited territories]] of the world by estimated total population. It is based on estimates published by the [[United Nations]] in the 2024 revision of ''[[World Population Prospects]]''. It presents population estimates from 1950 to the present.<ref name=UN>{{cite web|url=https://population.un.org/wpp/ |title=World Population Prospects, 2024 Revision|publisher=[[United Nations Department of Economic and Social Affairs]], Population Division}} "It presents population estimates from 1950 to the present".</ref>__TOC__

== List ==
Data are mid-year estimates from the United Nations and are for 2022 and 2023.<ref name=UN/>
